Restore writing rules and protected forms as authoring guidance without introducing deterministic character, word, punctuation, paragraph, or prose validators or enforcement gates
Consolidate documentation audience guidance from scattered files (AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/README.md) into canonical docs/documentation-policy.md with enforcement-aware pointers
Relocate generated-artifact inventory tables from docs/README.md to docs/generated-artifacts.md and repoint all existing inventory consumers to the new location
Require ticket corrections through append-only events and ADR corrections without erasing decision substance through annotations, errata, or replacement ADRs
Preserve historical content (catalog descriptions, generated outputs, ticket events, ADR substance) without repository-wide prose rewrite or edits to protected evidence
